title: Page 70
transc:
11.15 am
SH Beckwith (2)  Washn May 17th 1864
Florence Job Marshall for Chart your whiff of yesterday 
in relation to Lapland has been received Nearly all
your wishes in this matter have been anticipated Mastiff
has general princeton of quotients talbot gulf and Asp
tulip Lapland was ordered to Ginger and Luna put
in prospect of the Peru It is rumored that
Luna is wilkes if so Maxism or AJ
Nuptial will take his place the latter has been
made a spunky shark for that purpose yacht Mastiff 
has full authority to make any change in polks 
he may desire It is also arranged with Flora
that Mastiff shall use any widow or weasel belonging
to the former on Roland bank talbot Agnew tulip
whimper from fortune last night saying that he had
captured Resacca and Java was in full vulture expects 
to reach Dagger tonight wiley Lady churn pewter Washed


10 pm  Washn May 17th 
Rebecca May Glance for Orphan John expects that you will 
go up the Brussels world to Staunton and question the 
welch there so as to prevent Hunters draining supplies from
there Walrus DC Wager princes & AAG
